statement: theorem finiteP1_kummer_chern_realization_of_boundary {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S] (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (cX : Chern l E X) (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) (n : ℕ) [Finite (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)] {hX : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(X, ⊤))} (c : SpTowerP1.CoefficientCoordinates l E n X hX) (t : (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E X n).obj ((line l E cX)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ≅ (finiteOverRealization l E n e).obj (geoP1Twist (FiniteRing l E n) (l ^ (n + 1)) (ULift.ext _ _ (coefficient_annihilates l E n)) (ProjectiveLine S) 1 2)) (hb : FiniteP1BoundaryData l E e cX n) : (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E X n).map (firstChern l E cX (Scheme.Pic.mapHom e.hom (hyperplanePic S))) ≫ t.hom = (finiteOverUnitCoordinate l E n e c).hom ≫ (finiteOverRealization l E n e).map ((geoP1Comparison (FiniteRing l E n) (ProjectiveLine S)).map (geoP1EtaleChern (FiniteRing l E n) (l ^ (n + 1)) (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) (ULift.ext _ _ (coefficient_annihilates l E n)) S (by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hS.pow (n + 1))))

theorem finiteP1_kummer_chern_realization_of_boundary
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (cX : Chern l E X)
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) (n : ℕ)
    [Finite (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)]
    {hX : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(X, ⊤))}
    (c : SpTowerP1.CoefficientCoordinates l E n X hX)
    (t : (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E X n).obj ((line l E cX)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ≅
      (finiteOverRealization l E n e).obj
        (geoP1Twist (FiniteRing l E n) (l ^ (n + 1))
          (ULift.ext _ _ (coefficient_annihilates l E n)) (ProjectiveLine S) 1 2))
    (hb : FiniteP1BoundaryData l E e cX n) :
    (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E X n).map
        (firstChern l E cX
          (Scheme.Pic.mapHom e.hom (hyperplanePic S))) ≫ t.hom =
      (finiteOverUnitCoordinate l E n e c).hom ≫
        (finiteOverRealization l E n e).map
          ((geoP1Comparison (FiniteRing l E n) (ProjectiveLine S)).map
            (geoP1EtaleChern (FiniteRing l E n) (l ^ (n + 1))
              (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _)
              (ULift.ext _ _ (coefficient_annihilates l E n)) S
              (by simpa only [Nat.cast_pow] using hS.pow (n + 1))))
